# Code of Conduct

This applies to every participant, whether human or not, and to every interaction in the repositories of the organization: issues, pull requests, reviews, commit messages and discussions.

## Expected behavior

- Respect the other participants.
- Keep the discussion on the technical content.

## Unacceptable behavior

- Harassment, insults and personal attacks.
- Publishing private information of others without their permission.
- Spam, and posts unrelated to the repository.

## Enforcement

- The maintainer may edit, hide or delete a comment, close an issue or a pull request, and block a participant from the organization.
- Do not open a public issue for a problem. Report it privately to the public email of the maintainer listed in [Role](./CONTRIBUTING.md#role).
- The maintainer keeps the identity of the reporter confidential.
